rootwrap_config.description: Path to the rootwrap configuration file used to elevate privileges.

rpc_backend.description: RPC backend to use (e.g., rabbit, redis, or messaging v2).

rabbit_host.description: Hostname or IP of RabbitMQ server.

rabbit_password.description: Password for RabbitMQ authentication (required in production).

state_path.description: Base directory for runtime state files.

dhcp_agents_per_network.description: Number of DHCP agents to handle each network (enables high availability).

dhcp_driver.description: DHCP driver to use (e.g., Dnsmasq, external, or custom).

enable_isolated_metadata.description: Enable metadata service for isolated networks (requires NAT).

enable_metadata_network.description: Enable metadata network (required when using isolated metadata with NAT).

metadata_proxy_shared_secret.description: Shared secret for authenticating metadata proxy requests (must match server config).

interface_driver.description: Interface driver for plug/unplug devices (OVS, LinuxBridge, or custom).

metadata_driver.description: Metadata driver for handling instance metadata.

dhcp_lease_time.description: DHCP lease time in seconds (default: 24 hours).

dns_servers.description: List of DNS servers for instances (IPv4 or IPv6 addresses).

network_namespace.description: Prefix for network namespaces (if namespaces enabled).

pid_file.description: Path to PID file for the DHCP agent process.

ovs_integration_bridge.description: Open vSwitch integration bridge name (for OVS driver).

linux_bridge_physical_device_mappings.description: Map physical networks to devices for Linux Bridge driver.

dhcp_mtu.description: MTU to send in DHCP options (overrides interface MTU).

use_namespaces.description: Enable per-network namespaces (required for overlapping IPs).

dhcp_agents.description: [Deprecated] Number of DHCP agents; use `dhcp_agents_per_network` instead.

enable_dhcp_opt121.description: Enable DHCP option 121 (classless static route) for improved routing.

host.description: Hostname or identifier for this agent (must match nova/neutron config).

auth_type.description: Authentication type (e.g., password, token, or application credential).

insecure.description: Allow insecure TLS connections (disable certificate verification).

cafile.description: Path to CA bundle for TLS verification (if insecure=false).

polling_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between resource updates from Neutron server.
